summary: Meta Platforms filed a Rule 424(b)(5) preliminary prospectus supplement for a six-tranche offering of senior unsecured notes with maturities spanning 20xx, ranking pari passu with existing unsecured senior indebtedness. Terms including principal amounts, coupons, and maturity dates are left blank pending pricing, with Citigroup and Morgan Stanley as joint book-running managers. Notes would pay semiannual interest beginning 2027, carry optional make-whole and tax-redemption provisions, clear via Clearstream/Euroclear in minimum 100,000 denominations, and be listed on Nasdaq Bond Exchange. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation; watch for final coupon and size once priced.
